topics.title: Reading verse: the parrot asks what a traffic jam is
topics.why_no_lab: A tiny two-line verse with a joke; it is read aloud and enjoyed, then discussed with a picture of a real road.

topics.title: Talk: why do roads get crowded and how do we stay safe?
topics.why_no_lab: Road safety is a class conversation with a teacher; a screen lab cannot give a fixed answer.
